title: pilosella soleiroliana
intro: Pilosella soleiroliana, commonly known as Field Saxifrage, is a perennial plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties which provide health benefits such as wound healing and the reduction of fever. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella soleiroliana include its antioxidant, analgesic, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating pain and infections. The bioactive constituents of Pilosella soleiroliana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
